notes.title: Birthday Update
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow artists!

Happy birthday to Antipaint! Make a wish, blow out the candles and check out this massive new update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/73862f29b0ed82342a50e4a16e68264e4d4548f7.gif

Today, four new bosses join the Antipaint roster. We've got Cucumbersome Art, a Ruler For The Weekend, Urban Sprawl and... an Elderly Lady..? You'll find them waiting for you, alongside other works of art. Good luck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/38f41d383105a4b2e1d5d48ef474d42b1ce54073.gif

To help you out, your arsenal has been expanded with 20 new items. Become a hermit. Practice martial arts. Take a boombox with you. Wear fuzzy pink slippers. There's something in there for everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/c78b1b75d6229e3d6a5a0ba922774f1629b15b97.gif

You'll also find new options in the shop. Perhaps you feel like selling out? Or working a soul-crushing job to pay the bills? We've got you covered!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/d6dd81c270553bd7b6f487ea0a7d3c81d334a6c6.gif

This update also features a lot of tweaks, optimizations and other various changes. You might also find a new enemy type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/5842baa01181dc6e75d265df9ce8b09ba6de884b.gif

Last but not least, Antipaint is now available on Nintendo Switch! 

We worked very hard on this update and hope you'll enjoy it.

notes.title: Coffee Update!

Our latest Antipaint update introduces a bunch of yummy beverages that will make your artistic journey much more exciting!

notes.title: Rainbow Update!
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We're very excited to present the rainbow update! Just like a rainbow, this update has a little bit of everything and explores new mechanics through the aspect of randomness.

We're introducing a rainbow character that has a unique mechanic of randomizing the last 3 items you've got. With this character, the playing field is constantly evolving and buying an item becomes a tool to lock in your current gear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/1e03ccb7d3a66afdd4464f722ca2e8f94532c229.gif

Since we're talking about rainbows, if you decide to follow the way of the rainbow, you'll be rewarded with a pot of gold at the end.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/d7e7fa1ceda747a23f4aacd96214b1762cc14fee.gif

Alongside the new starting choices you'll find the option to start a run with a random palette, character and/or brush. If you're ever unsure of what tools to use - you can let fortune decide.

The palette selection has also been expanded with some neat prismatic palettes. They are unique as they don't have a predetermined set of colors to use. Instead, they generate a random color for each enemy, based on some rules. This should lead to some interesting and more dynamic works of art.

The roster of enemies has been expanded with a few enemies - the fish and the bull. The fish enemies appear in the earlier levels and will dive under the canvas to avoid player attacks. The bull is a tough fella' with a powerful charge attack and he can be found in the later levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/ab716f49e953114c1715ea3a1d4e66981bf64ba4.gif

Last, but not least, we're introducing the water balloon brush! It's a chargeable brush where holding the attack button will increase the balloon in size. Releasing the attack button will fire the projectile. If it hits any enemies, it will explode, taking out nearby foes. The bigger the balloon - the bigger the explosion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/f3b90811b23ea1e3f0740ff3bb7eef61568edc3b.gif

In the background there have also been plenty of fixes and optimizations, as well as an engine upgrade. The game should run even better, especially on weaker hardware.

notes.title: Finger Painting Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow artists!

Today's update introduces a new paint brush into your tool belts. It's a painting tool that we're all too familiar with - fingers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/9c34d6fd0b69c5063d672ab03a7360a9816e9b94.gif

"Finger painting" is a brush that has very short range, very high damage and a lightning fast dash attack that allows you to smear enemies across the canvas. It's tricky to use and requires precise positioning for maximum effectiveness.

The Finger Painting update also features several character reworks. The goal of these changes is to make the characters more distinct from one another, while maintaining their core essence. For example, the lemon character is all about the money - it starts the game with a purse and interest, but it also becomes slightly weaker with each item you buy. Cursed to hoard a ton of money, but afraid to spend it. The lime character is all about speed and mobility so it's health has been reduced, but it now spawns lime wedges that give a temporary buff to the player. Several other characters have been reworked - you can find all the changes in the release notes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/04e80dcd2ed9ff7ec1eaf1938c065109a0e9d936.gif

A few new items have also been added into the game. One of them is Interest - it gives you money when you beat a level, based on how much money you currently have. Another is the mighty Tesla Coil that zaps enemies and becomes stronger if you have a lot of energy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/28a797a7945378c48ecf879b7aed3d3f64a2f51b.gif

Lastly we've got a few balance changes, fixes, tweaks and quality of life improvements.

Hope you enjoy the Finger Painting update! Stay tuned for more even updates!

notes.title: Ascension Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Ascension Plane!

Today's update introduces the concepts of Ascensions and Burdens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/af0bb35aacb48ac9dcc4ca1efb922818edd2d4d7.gif

Ascensions are unlocked when you beat the game with maximum fame. You start at Ascension level 1 and at the start of the game you can pick up one Burden. As the name implies, Burdens have a negative effect that you'll have to bear for the whole run. If you manage to beat the game with the Burden, you'll gain an Ascension level. Higher Ascension levels require a larger amount of Burdens, thus making runs more and more difficult as you Ascend further and further. There's a (not so) special character that you can unlock by Ascending with all 10 Burdens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/30342b8499a13b6952c150e17969bb59154a3a61.gif

This update also features a character rework - the Pure character is now permanently capped at 1 max health point and any extra health points get converted into attack speed. The aim of this change is to highlight the "glass cannon" nature of the Pure character, making the single health point and very fast attack speed the core identity of this little fella.

There are now more achievements in the game to nudge players towards playing with different characters and to reward successful experimentation. Lastly, there are various fixes, tweaks and changes that you can read up on in the full release notes.

More updates coming soon, so stay tuned!

Enjoy!

Release Notes:

 Added an ascension system. After you beat the game for the first time, you'll be greeted with an ascension plane in the next playthrough. Carry burden items to the very end in order to ascend further. Each ascension level requires more burdens, gradually making each run harder and harder.
 Pure character reworked - it is now permanently stuck at one health point. Additional health points are converted into attack speed.

notes.title: Development Update #8
notes.notes:
Greetings!
We're back with another development update. Here's what we've been cooking!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/d7d3c8f48d9986c15dcfa65ea3321a48393ed81d.gif

Item Sets
You can now collect themed item sets. At first you can only obtain a single starter item from a set, but once you grab it, all the other items become available. Feel like becoming a robot that generates art? There's an item set just for you! Do you think food is the ultimate form of art? We've got you covered! All the item sets will be available in the full game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/7ed24a0dd7e19f7ccadd3537c77c52628949af18.gif

More Choices
More choices have been added into the game. You can choose different paths to progress through the game, with different challenges and rewards. You can complete mini quests to get powerful items and then you can use the paint mixer to trade them in for a different item. Alongside that, many new items have also been added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/0e07d441d1154ed409fd4871d0c74bbc43279a14.gif

Demo Overhaul
The demo received a significant overhaul. It's now longer, features more items, different brushes and two bosses. Check it out! Let us know what you think! Analytics have also been added, but they are optional. They should help us tweak and balance the game, so it helps a lot if you allow them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/cce105bccae7cb5d78619e2945b128e9d7033d69.gif

Other Stuff
A lot of other minor changes have been done. There's now an inventory screen which you can open with TAB. The enemies leave giblets on the floor when popped. There's fancy new music! Antipaint is coming along nicely, so if you can - play the demo, spread the word and keep on painting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/46c9e5d60c865c0894f0f834aacbf1149da357a1.gif

notes.title: Development Update 2023-04-15
notes.notes:
Greetings! It's time for another development update. I've been working on a lot of very cool things and I'm excited to show you everything. Let's go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/9df7c716c3c9418ec6a1f2483e1dfc42d3dc3ed3.gif

Playable Characters
As you can see in the new trailer, Antipaint now features 7 playable characters, each with a different flavor. All characters feature different strengths and weaknesses, allowing you to jump into the game with a different playstyle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/252752d0f8aefde497ecb83dd577f10dbc39bd29.gif

We've got the basic well-rounded Vanilla, then there's the glass cannon Sky and also Lavender that starts the game with a bunch of painting buddies plus a bunch more. I'm excited to see what kind of builds and strategies everyone will try and use with each character!

Brush Rework
The brushes have been slightly tweaked, balanced and in some cases reworked. The powerful supermoves now use less energy but also have a lesser effect, so you can use them more frequently, but also be able to save up energy for items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/9898fece3c422daa8d7fd5d559fdbf1420532d73.gif

Brush upgrades are now also a thing - you can buy them in the shop and each brush has a unique effect that you can enhance with several levels of upgrades. Fire additional droplets, make projectiles bouncy, steal energy on hit - all part of the upgrade system.

Fame and Shop Improvements
Antipaint now also tracks your level of fame. If you do well, your fame level increases and you gain access to better items, plus some other side-effects. The item shop itself has also become a much livelier place, featuring brush upgrades, a painting auction and branching exit paths.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/583bb7b93d028a37208cb8e75fef1ebc5717d9eb.gif

Will you dare enter the rainbow and to try and get some special rewards?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/bf3be9e5f202d1ae9268a526973c3c091653a4bc.gif

Other things
The game visuals have also been slightly adjusted, the player and enemies are larger and there's a bit of a side-view perspective going on, which looks a lot better, especially in boss fights. It also allows the characters to have fun little walking animations, breathing a bit more life into the game.

I've also added a bunch of content into Antipaint - bosses, items, enemies, painting styles have joined the existing roster, increasing it substantially, with even more content to come. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/af1973d0cc285d6989c6a062b930dbe0ddf41eb8.gif

I feel that Antipaint is nearing it's release and I'm very excited to see everyone play!

Until next time!
Vilius

notes.title: Development Update 2022-01-22
notes.notes:
Hello there!

It's been a while, so here's a progress update on Antipaint and all the cool stuff I've added since my last post.

Items
A very fun aspect of making a roguelike is coming up with all sort of crazy and fun items. To that end, Antipaint now has almost 50 items. I had a great time implementing these and I still have quite a few item ideas left so the list of items is only going to grow bigger!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/88ac7750161f2db3abc24e20286b90635add8695.gif

Paint Surge
I've added a new mechanic into Antipaint - the paint surge. It happens when you splat enough enemies in a short amount of time. Once in a paint surge, you shoot and move faster. There are also several items that interact with the paint surge, allowing you to build a character that can rely on surges to deal with foes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/685b55803d5e5e42d3846b8bafc1ca1880c1c61d.gif

New Art Styles
Ever wanted to make mosaics like Gaudi? Now, you can! I've added a bunch of shape-based art styles that you will get when playing the game, creating even more cool and unique art!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/7ca16878f76fe7a7df4ea2952c598f42eadeaf5b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/30fd76459381bba7f33bfb66e74eef74416c203c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/85f6b23445ca6e9dad3b865cb8852a1a63e8fcb0.png

Color Fight
A cool new level that you get is a color fight. In it, two colors battle each other to control the largest area of the canvas. The winner will give the player a unique, color-specific item that can only be obtained through color fights.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/6e4972ccf7e5b937a87b31b2d05b5795ff4b907f.gif

Other Improvements
There are many more changes - there is now an item shop, the UI was changed, there are new enemy types... If you want to see all the cool new things that I'm working on, join our discord server! I post regular updates there. You can also share your own ideas, give feedback and be the first to hear about new and great things coming to Antipaint. See you there!

Join Our Discord Server!

notes.title: Development Update 2021-07-12
notes.notes:
Greetings, celebrated creators!

It's been a while, so here's an update on the stuff I've been working on so far.

Roguelike
One of the biggest, latest and greatest changes - Antipaint is becoming a roguelike. The core gameplay will remain the same - you will still be battling baddies that leave paint trails and each level you beat will still become an awesome and unique piece of art. Additionally, you'll also be visiting some crazy places and grabbing items along the way. Each item will affect you in fun and unique ways, making each playthrough different and interesting. Each level will also be randomly generated, so you'll end up with a large variety of paintings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/5a02db999d7da1fc1a60720355feca0c69ed5cee.gif

There's still a lot of work to be done, but I feel like we're moving in the right direction. Playing this way feels nice and immediate, you get into a flow of creating tons of different paintings without even noticing it, which is exactly what I want Antipaint to be!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/f84c15ba0b9260a1ac86e10a3652cb3ec6e3d7e2.gif

The little details
I've been tweaking the look and feel of the game. The enemies now have tiny little hands and they reach towards the player if he gets too close. The enemies have eye expressions and they blink! These really minor things, but I feel like they make the game look much nicer.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/32bc3a54c3c9e1eb634ac95d70838e2747c8081f.gif

New Boss
I've also been working on a new abstract cat boss. It bounces around and sends kittens towards the player. Neat!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/b61ba9e5d37f7c4a40722bf4b7736fee88bf5a55.gif

Options menu
One of the less fun but must-have things is an options menu. It took a while, but I got it working - you can now tweak things like the paint brightness and screenshake amount. This will have to be expanded to include more settings in the future.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/c95cf785d852ab29dca0d4a82401806f0c0855f5.gif

There's been a lot of stuff done in these last few months. Most of it was working on the roguelike aspects of the game, but I'm sure I've missed a few details here and there. If you want to see more regular updates on the game, be sure to jump in our discord server. Cheers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/d4edf525f3baf2c0f8324f2b2302feae9cdfe5d3.gif

notes.title: Development Update 2021-04-18
notes.notes:
Hello there, Determined Doodlers!

Here's a monthly update on the stuff I've been working on.

Steam integration
This month marked the milestone of uploading the first game builds to steam and integrating some neat steam features like leader boards and cloud saving. This puts us one step closer to being able to release and gives way to some fun game modes like...

Daily doodle
A challenge mode where you compete for the top score on a randomly generated level. The level is the same for all players around the world and is regenerated each day. You will now be able to show off your skills and determine the best artist daily!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/ffdd8b51b5ef2bb64140ac78e487a9dd49a89a3e.gif

Survival mode
One more special game mode that came to life this month is the survival mode. Here, the goal is to stay alive for as long as possible. The level is infinite, the enemy variety changes over time and everything gets harder and harder the longer you survive. If you've ever wanted to fill every part of the canvas with paint - this is the game mode for you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/23338b6ee370ffa1f3387f47369ef0c4142f8a14.gif

Glow in the dark paint
I've added some neon glow levels into Antipaint. So now the paintings you end up with can have a nice futuristic neon sign feeling.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/867711fb5d9edcb0e12ac6b8e8ef0db18785a47d.gif

Other changes and tweaks
I've also added a bunch of minor features and tweaks to the game. If you narrowly avoid an enemy, you get some extra points and a neat little popup to indicate your close call. The level loading transition received a facelift and now looks like proper brush strokes covering your screen. There have also been various UI tweaks and fixes and some game balance changes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/9407dbda9d998d8cf9e1d8f23c9236aee3d2a86c.gif

Once again, thank you for reading and if you like what you see, make sure to wishlist Antipaint to get notified when it comes out. Cheers!

notes.title: Development Update 2021-03-18
notes.notes:
Greetings, Striving Sketchers!

A month has passed, therefore allow me to show you what's been cooking!

Procedurally generated levels
In the world of indie games one of the most common thing you could encounter would be procedural generation... and screenshake.

Antipaint already had its fair dose of screenshake, so it was high time for me to implement procedural level generation. It's a neat little system that uses a wide variety of preset spawn patterns, a randomized enemy roster, a literal difficulty curve and a few other fiddly bits to create unique levels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/3a6e1d3d657a2585ab9de94b42f6db43e89d20c9.gif
It can create levels of varying length, difficulty and artistic styles for the infinite enjoyment of the player. It's a well needed breath of fresh air and allows for some very fun capabilities like daily doodle challenges, infinite levels or just plain old procedural levels. I want people to be able to create unique paintings each time they play and the procedural generation system has huge potential in that regard. Needless to say, I am very pleased.

Snakes
Oh no, some slimy slithering snakes have invaded Antipaint! Only a true master painter can defeat these foul beasts!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/dc060a52ac3d51dbcb76471d04200368ea39892d.gif

Improved visuals & sounds
Last month I spent a lot of time tweaking and changing the game UI. I'm not done with it yet, but I like where it's going. I've also tweaked the visuals of a few projectiles and added a few neat sounds, courtesy of my friend, CookieSalad. Thanks!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/7b0234b5361364d2b397cc8eeb9449b66cd9cf26.gif

Everything Explodes
I've added an "everything explodes" modifier into the game. It creates some sick chain reactions where an exploding enemy causes nearby enemies to explode. It's a fun little gimmick and it will be very fun to create a few levels with it. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/b92fb30b5171dc8c256e782258be79776a1e76d2.gif

Other Things
Meanwhile I've also been working on a few premade levels, fixing a bunch of bugs, adjusted some particle sizes and various other tweaks and tidbits. Progress, progress, progress!

Thank you for your interest in Antipaint. If you hadn't already, please wishlist and follow the game for more news and updates. I really appreciate it :)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418390/Antipaint/

notes.title: Development Update 2021-02-18
notes.notes:
Greetings, Prospective Painters!

It's time for another Antipaint development update. Here's what I've been working on.

Camera Zoom
Just after posting the previous development update, TheDane from our discord server suggested a neat little feature - the ability to zoom out to see the whole painting. So I implemented it. Cool!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/7ae58dc12f353a786661e77502478e38d869f9a3.gif

Boss Fights
Antipaint needed a big baddie battle. So I began experimenting with a boss design. I want the final game to feature several different bosses, all with their own unique quirks. This one is a bit simple, he charges at you, then turns around and does it again. If you hit it enough, it will start spawning minions and moving faster. Simple, but effective.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/47a42db1029b050c676fff8c52e421883bac9cce.gif

Scaredy Enemies
In order to shake things up a bit I've added an enemy that runs away from you instead of running towards you. With this [strike]groundbreaking[/strike] design it becomes a bit easier to paint something you want as you can guide these little fellas to where you want them to be. Or you can just splat them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/55e78bb41bc241f1d220f4909253034b00634689.gif

Symmetry
I've toyed around with the idea of symmetry and I am really liking the results. It allows me to create very different and neat-looking paintings. It also adds some complexity into the game as it's a bit harder to spot the enemies as there are several moving lines on screen that do not contain enemies. Neat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/8b2cc965f46540550341b763a423528b02368598.gif

Demo Build
I've recently released a demo build on itch.io to gather some feedback. You can check it out here. Please hop on the discord server afterwards and share your thoughts!

Other Things
I've also been spending some time on refining and optimizing the UI and getting things to work with a controller. These tasks aren't as fun or glamorous, but you've got to do them. Apart from that I've also tweaked some animations, added some neat little camera bobbing, changed up a few sprites and fixed various issues. 

It's been a productive month and things are moving along nicely.

notes.title: Development Update 2021-01-17
notes.notes:
Greetings Aspiring Artists!

Thank you for your interest in Antipaint - here's a quick update on what I've been working on.

Powerups
If I'm making a hectic, arcade twinstick shoot 'em up it has to have powerups. It's probably the law. Therefore, I've added powerups to Antipaint! So far there are only three - a super painting speed powerup that makes you paint faster, a big blot buff that makes your paint droplets bigger and an orbital orb buff that creates an orbital orb that orbits around you, striking down anything it touches. Neat!

Here's the three powerups in action:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/e69b9e62ac4e8b7fc3b1d270f7da7464019edff8.gif

Splat Styles
I've been expanding upon the arsenal of splats. Different splats lead to different paintings, so having a nice variety here is key to a diverse gallery for every player.

Here's a few paintings you could end up with:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/bd5cb62c9aa37f1affd659d05da069a1c7446e71.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/9b73ce260c4cb070ea9bd8862b0609443aa37d44.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/06570ecef27603922585ab772b8ff7303aa73ec9.png

New Brush
There's a new "brush" in town - the paint roller! It's the first melee brush - it doesn't shoot any projectiles. Instead, you must whack the enemies close and personal. While other brushes have a limited-use super move to get you out of tight spots, the paint roller has an infinite-use dash/roll attack. 

It's very fast, very mobile and very different from the rest of the tools you've got. It's hard to master, but I'm very pleased to have it in the game.

Here's the paint roller in action:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/36fd7040b91abb453fe8d1763ddeb91af83e33f5.gif
Note how the roller becomes bigger after picking up the big blot buff!

Other Oddities
I've been experimenting with a few other ideas. One of which is heavily inspired by the game "Super Hot" - time moves when you do. It's a very simple, yet incredibly fun idea. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212421/7317b72ece3fd2335d1f7f3d7cdb56aac1513ae3.gif
I'm still thinking about how it could be integrated in the game, maybe have it appear in a few levels only. Those levels would give some nice variety and provide some rest from the regular gameplay. That also gets me thinking about what other game modifiers I could throw into the mix...

There's also been some progress on the user interface, game state saving and other less interesting parts of any game. 

Overall, I'd say the game is moving along nicely. Thank you for reading this update! If you have any feedback, ideas or just want to say hi, please drop by on our Discord server!

Cheers!
